name: Hentai Seiheki Dominance - Femdom of Paraphilia
original_name: 変態性癖ドミナンス - Femdom of Paraphilia
source: Following a bad end of the previous game, the protagonist is working at Mizue's fitness club when he ends up meeting two new heroines, an elegant young lady and a new female instructor.
translation: 承接前作坏结局，主人公在瑞江的健身俱乐部工作，并在那里遇见两名新的女主角：一位端庄的年轻女士，以及一名新来的女教练。
